# Coherent support admission without positive physical fault flags

29 October 2026. Root construction; independent challenge in progress.
Historical novelty UNKNOWN. These are conditional receiver theorems, not a
physical quantum-memory or fault-tolerant-computation demonstration.

## 1. Input that is actually required

On a finite set V of N labelled fault slots let F_M, M subset V, be one
CONSISTENT family of Hermiticity-preserving linear process maps. For the
fixed experiment, sum_M F_M is the actual CPTP process. All initial
environment registers, interventions and final receivers are included in
the map or admitted as common contractions in its complete strategy norm.
Assume, uniformly over the exogenous schedules used below,

    B(R) = sum_(M superset R) F_M,
    ||B(R)|| <= epsilon^|R|,       R subset V.                 (1)

F_M need not be CP. There is no positive probability law on M in this
assumption. The R=empty bound is just the norm-one physical full process.
Every support assertion below is an additional input; (1) alone does not
assert spatial locality, an ideal reference, or successful error correction.

For disjoint T,Z define a forced/forbidden hybrid by

    H(T,Z) = sum_(M: T subset M, M intersect Z=empty) F_M.

Finite inclusion-exclusion gives the useful exact identity and bound

    H(T,Z) = sum_(U subset Z) (-1)^|U| B(T union U),
    ||H(T,Z)|| <= epsilon^|T| (1+epsilon)^|Z|.          (2)

This explicitly pays the cost of forbidding faults on a boundary. It is
not an assumption that arbitrary normalized conditioned channels are close.

## 2. Cancellation for the component bad event

Fix ANY finite graph H on V, and integer d>=1. Put b(M)=1 if H[M] has a
connected component with >=d vertices, otherwise 0, and define

    a_R = sum_(S subset R) (-1)^(|R|-|S|) b(S).

Boolean inversion gives, as an exact identity of maps,

    sum_M b(M) F_M = sum_R a_R B(R).                        (3)

We have |a_R|<=2^|R|. More usefully, a_R=0 whenever H[R] has even ONE
component of size <d. Proof: g=1-b factorizes on the components C_i of
H[R], and its Mobius coefficient on R is the product of its coefficients
on the C_i. On a component of size <d, g is identically1 on all subsets;
its nonempty coefficient is (1-1)^|C_i|=0. For nonempty R the constant
function has zero coefficient, so a_R(b)=-a_R(g). Also a_empty=0.

Consequently

    ||sum_bad F_M||

This is a corollary of PROOF.md for a concrete continuum-noise model.
It is not a logical-memory lifetime theorem.

and nominal Pauli-times-check recovery operations of PROOF.md Section5.

X_j, |X_j|<=q, touches<=b checks; a check meets<=K seed supports. All these
constants count actual supplied operations/supports, not just their names.

The nominal clock/bath environment can have arbitrary strength and memory
provided its joint source action is sum_s Pi_s tensor H_s(t), identity on
the logical algebra. Initial source encoding is syndrome diagonal with
logical-input-independent weights, and the environment is independent of
the logical input. Add independent centered Gaussian DATA-noise baths,
factorized initially from source/nominal environment, with couplings

    alpha sum_j A_j(t) tensor B_j(t), ||A_j(t)||<=1.

Precisely, H_tot=H_good tensor I_noise + I_good tensor sum_j H_Bj
+ alpha sum_j A_j tensor B_j. H_good acts TRIVIALLY on these data baths;
their H_Bj are the specified source-independent free Gaussian Hamiltonians.
A_j acts only on source/clock/nominal-environment factors. Arbitrary separate
CLOCK baths may be part of H_good, not hidden additional couplings to the
same Gaussian data fields.

# Independent all-size proof of the asynchronous enumeration

29 October2026. Analytic review/clarification, not a finite-graph extrapolation.
No new graph/model/trajectory or scalar fixture is executed. The input is the
literal independent occurrence-flag model of root_coherent_admission/PROOF.md.

## 1. Filtration that survives overlapping scans

Write O_v for independent virtual Bernoulli(theta) occupations, except a
FIXED prescribed root set S, all of which is occupied from the outset.
These auxiliary variables are independent of every exogenous read flag
Z_(a,k), with P(Z=1)>=1/2 independently for every check a/block k.
The roots are fixed BEFORE these variables are drawn. The later polymer
enumeration fixes S and filters eligible sets inside the expectation; it
does not condition on S having been selected by a realized graph.

Start a FIFO queue with all roots. Mark them discovered/queued. Process each
discovered vertex once. At an occupied vertex v=(j,k), for each check touched
by j, first expose every still-unknown occupation in that check's row k.
Enqueue new occupied vertices immediately. Then scan in either direction
from the adjacent block to the first read flag1 inclusive or the time boundary.
At every visited row expose all its unknown occupations BEFORE revealing a
previously unknown flag. Cache both. Previously discovered occupied vertices,
including queued roots, are never new children.

The invariant is:

    Every REVEALED read flag has a COMPLETELY exposed occupation row.

It holds initially and is maintained by the prescribed order. A known zero
flag can therefore be crossed without producing new children. A known flag1
ends the scan and also has no hidden children. An own-block exposure may
leave its read flag unrevealed; a later scan can reveal that flag, but its
occupation row is already complete. Partial exposures caused by another
check only reduce the number of new Bernoulli variables in the row.

under this adaptive filtration; all unexposed flags remain independent with
success probability at least1/2. The proof must not condition on the full
already-realized read graph while asserting this deferred-decision property.
